scope: Coordinated local MCU VCORE/+3V3/GND relayout study; accepted design bytes unchanged.

identity_basis.C17: 1uF/25V capacitor between +3V3 and GND. Native connectivity places C17.1 in the broad +3V3 group; this does not prove a dedicated association with any single IC1 supply pin.
identity_basis.C18: 0.1uF DVDD23 decoupler; pad 1 GND currently isolated

evaluated_topology.name: rejected_east_F_spine_plus_dual_transition_In2_backbone
evaluated_topology.summary: One coordinated trial moved only C6/C7/C8/C17/C18, attempted to join DVDD50 and VREG_VOUT45 locally on F after replacing the two proved +3V3 blockers, transition VCORE to In2 south-west of BT1, cross on In2, return to F west of BT2, and give C18 a separate GND via. It failed the fixed-copper screen and is not proposed for implementation.
evaluated_topology.release_semantics: These were the exact local VCORE/+3V3/GND tracks removed only from the disposable obstacle model. They are not released for implementation. Every pad in their existing connected groups remains a required endpoint.
evaluated_topology.GND_return: The trial intended C6.1/C7.1/C8.2/C17.2 to remain on a refilled east F GND island feeding the accepted C13 stitch 8962d6a1-67d0-5647-ab62-4035ee08f832 / d5986491-6d78-52f6-99c9-86fbf841afcd, and C18.1 to receive a separate In1 via. The C18 via failed against fixed VHI/VBAT copper, so this return was not established.
evaluated_topology.plus3V3_restoration: The trial replaced the local C17 crossing and exact blockers d269dfaa-bef6-5f59-b918-0cefd4b841f2 and fcbd8a3e-d67e-55bf-bc7c-7f2822b47e3c in its disposable model, while requiring every existing +3V3 pad to be restored. Even with those removals, the tested F routes still encountered additional fixed +3V3, USB, VHI, VBAT, clock and debug copper.

prospective_fill_effects.F_Cu: Moved GND lands and new F routes require refill; local islands/clearance carves will change. The accepted C13 stitch and all five east-ground endpoints must remain one group.
prospective_fill_effects.In1_Cu: Three ordinary via antipads are prospective; both VCORE antipads must preserve MAIN continuity, while the C18 GND via must land in MAIN.
prospective_fill_effects.In2_Cu: VCORE backbone only; no plane or GND copper proposed.

screen_result.interpretation: Fixed native pads/tracks/vias and complete modeled contacts were screened. Moved footprints and released replacement tracks were removed from the obstacle set; zone fill was treated as refillable. This is not DRC, fill, PI, current, thermal, stackup or CAD qualification.

smallest_structural_constraint_requiring.constraint: No paired ordinary off-contact transition was established while preserving all fixed non-capacitor copper. The east trial via at (104.3,104.3) intersects fixed B.Cu VBAT item c2af96d9-1246-51a5-a97c-ca696ec0eb98. The west VCORE and C18-return trial vias at (94.9,103.3)/(94.9,104.2) intersect fixed full-span VHI item f2148815-45ba-5519-b656-60de22e1c38e and associated VHI/B copper; the west return also intersects fixed VBAT item 864bdadd-6d56-510d-9e10-e0d10d9c63f8.
smallest_structural_constraint_requiring.decision_needed: No broader release is justified by the rejected trial. Establish transition-access feasibility before selecting capacitor poses or local route geometry.
smallest_structural_constraint_requiring.bounded_conclusion: The retained trial proves only that its selected poses, routes and three preselected transition centres fail. It does not establish a need to alter VHI/VBAT or move components outside C6/C7/C8/C17/C18.

limits: No accepted PCB, manifest, project, library, CAD or zone definition was changed.
0.25 mm is a geometric screening width, not a current rating.
Route lengths cover only rejected trial primitives, not complete electrical loop lengths.
Physical stackup, voltage drop, transients, thermal behavior and manufacturing tolerances remain unqualified.

semantics.zones: F/In1 filled zone polygons omitted as refillable; prospective antipads/carves require later continuity review.
semantics.strict: All current native pads/tracks/vias are hard obstacles.
semantics.conditional: Only five moved-cap pad lands and exact candidate-local F +3V3/VCORE/GND tracks listed below are omitted. All other copper remains fixed.

restoration_dependencies: All currently connected VCORE endpoints must be restored.
Every pad in the existing +3V3 connected group must remain connected; C17 group membership is not a dedicated-pin assignment.
C6.1/C7.1/C8.2/C17.2 must remain connected through the accepted C13 stitch.
C18.1 requires a credible In1 MAIN return before west VCORE acceptance.

port_map_appendix.pair_semantics: A reported west pair is only two independently clear ordinary-via ports with >=0.20 mm copper-edge and >=0.25 mm drill-edge mutual clearance. It does not prove a C18 route, return loop, refill, DRC or PI result.
limits: No component pose or route was selected from this map.
No B VBAT/VHI, USB, QSPI, clock, IMU, contact, accepted stitch or other fixed geometry was released.
In1 MAIN intersection is a landing screen; full via-ring containment and post-refill plane continuity remain implementation checks.
